An [[Water/Legends|aquatic]] '''creature''' on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] had a rock-like head. While one of the creatures was in a river with its head poking above the surface, the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket]] used its head as a stepping stone after filling a sack with water from the river, causing the creature to raise its head above the water and snarl angrily, before descending again. It also had rock-like growths on its chin and cheek.<ref name="A" />

{{Creature-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The creature appeared in the [[Ewoks (television series)|''Ewoks'']] episode "Asha."<ref name="A" />
